model: E8951 gateway - E3xC branch circuit current meter profile
equipment_type: Power and energy meter (via E8951 BACnet gateway)
applies_to: Veris E30/E31 C-level branch circuit meters (current only, 42 branches and mains), read through a Veris E8951 Modbus-to-BACnet protocol converter.
summary: The Veris E8951 discovers supported Veris Modbus RTU meters and presents each one as its own BACnet device on BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP, with a fixed object profile per meter type. The E3xC profile is current-only: mains current, demand and max current, the same for 42 branch channels, alarm registers, CT sizes, alarm thresholds and per-channel reset outputs.
notes: Objects as printed in the E8951 Appendix 1 profile table; names are the table's Data Variable column (the guide does not spell out the BACnet Object_Name).
The E8951 creates one virtual BACnet device per discovered Modbus meter; default device instance = 50000 + Modbus address, default device name = meter series abbreviation + "_" + Modbus address.
The guide's text says 446 objects per address; the table lists 418 (210 AI, 164 AV, 44 AO).
AV 4-45 (CT size) are fixed at 100 A on E30C solid-core models; writable on E31C split-core.
E30Cx84 models and all E31C models use two Modbus addresses and appear as two BACnet devices with this profile.
E3x meters run at 9600, 19200 or 38400 baud.

source.title: E8951 Modbus-to-BACnet Protocol Converter Installation Guide

integration.summary: Wire the meters to the E8951 downstream port at one baud rate with no parity, power up in Discovery mode and wait 2-3 minutes; each meter then shows up as a device behind the E8951's virtual network. Read the energy, power and alarm objects; AVs and AOs are meter set-up and reset registers.

minimum_points.name: Global Resets: Write value to reset
minimum_points.why: Global reset command (write the listed code)

setup: E8951 converts Modbus RTU (downstream RS-485) to BACnet MS/TP (up to 76.8 kbps) or BACnet IP; DIP switches A6/A7 pick the protocol, A0-A6 set the MS/TP MAC.
Meters sit behind a virtual router network (default network number 50); change it in the web GUI if 50 is in use.
Device ID offset (default 50000) is set in the GUI; written device instances and names stick even in Discovery mode.
Set S3 to Discovery to find meters on power-up (2-3 minutes), then Locked to skip rediscovery; all meters need the same baud and no parity.
Limits: 32 meters and 10,000 BACnet points per E8951; BBMD via an uploaded bdt.ini.
gotchas: Invalid AV writes are not rejected over BACnet; read the value back after the next scan.
COV increments revert to their defaults and subscriptions are lost after a power cycle.
